configuration:
global
	log 127.0.0.1:3914   local0 warning
	maxconn 513
	maxpipes 128
	chroot /var/lib/haproxy
	user haproxy
	group haproxy
	stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock
	daemon
	 
defaults
	log     global
	mode    tcp
	option  dontlognull
	retries 3
	option redispatch
	option forwardfor
	option httpclose
	timeout connect    5000
	timeout client     50000
	timeout server     50000

listen stats_on_public
	bind 10.10.32.166:8081
	mode http
	option httpclose
	stats enable
	stats uri     /admin?stats
	stats realm   Haproxy\ Statistics
	stats auth    [REDACTED]

	 
listen 10_10_32_166-80
	bind 10.10.32.166:80
	mode http
	option httpclose
	acl network_allowed src 10.10.0.0/16 
	tcp-request connection reject if !network_allowed
	balance leastconn
	server 10_10_32_166-80_0 10.76.32.70:8080 check
